DRIFT / AMBIENT PAD JSMade for unhurried music. Headphones recommended.

A space to jam

Choose a key and one of six scales to see compatible triads and sevenths. Click a suggested chord to add it. Templates follow the selected key and scale. Selecting a scale guides your choices; existing notes stay in place until you use Transpose to key.

Auto voice leading keeps the first chord as an anchor and chooses compact voicings with less motion, including the loop seam. Smooth now applies it once; Reset voicings returns to the selected inversions. Individual inversion controls take effect when auto voice leading is off.

Press Play to hear the loaded progression. Choose one of eight presets, then open the sound sections to shape two oscillator layers, a filter envelope, slow pitch and pan motion, stereo chorus, reverb and delay. Filter envelope amount can be positive (opening) or negative (closing).

Load a progression or click a chord card to choose its root, quality, and inversion. Each chord has a start bar, start beat, duration in beats, and its own gap or overlap. Use the transition strip to apply one setting to all chord cards.

Use Select (V) and drag a box to select notes, or Shift-click to add/remove notes. Drag a selected note to move the whole group; drag its right edge to resize the group by the same amount. Alt-drag bypasses snap. Draw (B) adds notes and Erase (E) removes them. Double-click deletes a note. Click piano keys to preview notes. Note edits during playback are heard on the next loop; stop and play to hear them immediately.

Ctrl/Cmd+A selects all notes; C copies, X cuts, V pastes, and D duplicates (hold Ctrl/Cmd for each). Shift-click the ruler or set Paste at beat to choose the insert position. Click the ruler normally to seek playback. Zoom with the H/V controls or Ctrl/Cmd-wheel (horizontal) and Alt-wheel (vertical), centered at the pointer. Fit clip (F) shows the whole clip; Fit selection (Shift+F) frames selected notes. Shift-wheel scrolls horizontally. Drag the loop handles, set bar:beat loop positions (end is exclusive), or use Loop selection. Drag END on the ruler or change clip length to resize the clip. Follow playhead scrolls during playback. With Loop enabled, seeking stays inside the loop range. Space pauses/resumes; Stop returns to the loop start. WAV export always renders the full clip. The clipboard stays inside this studio. Arrows move selected notes by a snap step or semitone; Shift+arrows use a bar or octave. Delete removes the selection. Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y redoes. Velocity applies to every selected note. Manual timing/pitch edits detach only the affected chord cards.

Projects autosave on this device. Save project downloads a portable JSON file. Export WAV renders one pass with a release and reverb tail; the metronome is excluded.

Edit chord

Negative = gap · zero = connected · positive = overlap.
Overlap extends beyond the chord boundary, including the loop seam.
